metadata.title: TenK10K Phase 1 effector genes results
metadata.description:
Contents

Main results:

  • tenk10k_phase1_effector_genes.v5.parquet : the main results for single-cell eQTL Mendelian randomisation, sensitivity analyses, and colocalisation for every gene, cell type and trait tested in TenK10K Phase 1 (7.5 million rows)
  • tenk10k_phase1_effector_genes.v5.md: column descriptions of the main results file (also stored in the file's metadata)

Figure and table inputs:

  • tenk10k_figure_inputs.tar.gz : archived summary-level data, intermediate files, and annotations needed to rebuild figures and supplementary tables included in the manuscript Single-cell genetics identifies cell-type-specific effector genes across complex traits and diseases 
  • INVENTORY.tsv: inventory list of the manuscript input files, including information of the display items that use it, its source and its licence.
  • README.md: More details on the contents, usage instructions, licence, and citation

Citation

If you use these data in your research, please cite:
  • This zenodo record
  • The paper, if not yet published, the preprint: Henry A, Senabouth A, Tyebally R, et al. Single-cell genetics identifies cell-type-specific effector genes across complex traits and diseases. medRxiv 2025.08.28.25334614 (2025). doi:10.1101/2025.08.28.25334614

Access

This dataset will be made public at the time of manuscript publication

Correspondence

Joseph E. Powell (j.powell@garvan.org.au).
